title: can / can't
grammarNote:
"Can" — это модальный глагол. Он стоит ПЕРЕД основным глаголом и показывает: умеешь ли ты что-то делать, разрешено ли это, возможно ли это. В Казахском языке ему соответствует "-а алу / -е алу" (биле алу, жүзе алу).

CAN используется в четырёх главных случаях:

① Умение / способность (ABILITY) — это главное!
   "I can swim." · "She can speak five languages." · "He can't cook."

② Просьба (REQUEST) — вежливо попросить кого-то
   "Can you help me?" · "Can you explain this, please?"

③ Разрешение (PERMISSION) — попросить разрешения
   "Can I open the window?" · "Can I leave early today?"

④ Возможность (POSSIBILITY) — что-то может случиться
   "Learning languages can be fun!" · "It can be very difficult."

⚠️ САМОЕ ВАЖНОЕ ПРАВИЛО:
CAN никогда не меняется! Нет -s для He/She/It!
"She can" ✅ — НЕ "She cans" ❌
После CAN всегда стоит BASE FORM глагола:
"I can swim" ✅ — НЕ "I can swimming" ❌ — НЕ "I can to swim" ❌

grammarTable.subject: I / You / He / She / It / We / They
grammarTable.example: I can code. · She can sing. · They can dance. · He can swim.

grammarTable.subject: I / You / He / She / It / We / They
grammarTable.example: I can't drive. · He can't cook. · We can't fly. · She can't play guitar.

grammarTable.subject: Can + subject + verb?
grammarTable.example: Can you swim? · Can she code? · Can they help? · Can he speak English?

grammarExtra.title: ⚠️ Три главные ошибки с CAN — запомни навсегда!

rows.form: ❌ She cans play → ✅ She can play
rows.example: CAN никогда не получает -s! Для всех подлежащих одинаково.

rows.form: ❌ I can to swim → ✅ I can swim
rows.example: После CAN нет "to"! Только базовая форма глагола.

rows.form: ❌ He can swimming → ✅ He can swim
rows.example: После CAN нет -ing! Только базовая форма глагола.

rows.form: ❌ Can she sings? → ✅ Can she sing?
rows.example: В вопросе тоже базовая форма — никаких -s или -ing.
"I cannot drive." = "I can't drive." — оба верны.
В письме и официальном тексте используй cannot. В разговоре — can't.
I can't / You can't / He can't / She can't / We can't / They can't
Arlan can't cook. · Malika can't code. · Bekzat can't dance.
"Can you swim?" — "Yes, I can." / "No, I can't."

rows.form: Краткий ответ: Yes, I can. / No, I can't.

rows.example: "What can you do?" · "How well can she sing?" · "Where can I practise?"
"Can I ask you a question?" · "Can I use your pen, please?"
"Can you help me?" · "Can you explain this again?" · "Can you speak slowly?"
"When I was 10, I could swim very fast." (раньше умел)
"I couldn't speak English at school — now I can!"

rows.form: Правила те же: could + base form
rows.example: "She could dance when she was 5." — НЕ "She could danced."
"Could you help me, please?" — вежливее чем "Can you help me?"
"Bekzat could run faster last year. Now he can run even faster!"

grammarTip:
Формула CAN — проще некуда:

✅ [подлежащее] + can/can't + [глагол без изменений]

I can swim. · She can't cook. · Can you drive?

📌 Шпаргалка по can:
"can"   → умею, могу, разрешите?
"can't" → не умею, не могу
"Can?"  → умеешь? можно? можете?
"could" → умел раньше / вежливая просьба

💡 Лайфхак для ответов:
"Can you...?" → ТОЛЬКО "Yes, I can." или "No, I can't."
Никогда: "Yes, I can swim." — слишком длинно в кратком ответе!
Никогда: "Yes, I can't." — логическая ошибка!

exercises.text: Malika ___ sing beautifully — she won a competition.
exercises.hint: CAN never changes — no -s, no "to". "Malika can sing."

exercises.text: "He cans play chess very well" is correct English.
exercises.hint: CAN never gets -s! For all subjects: can. "He can play chess."
can't + base form ✅. Others: no 'to', no -s, no -ing after can.

exercises.instruction: Make the question. Write only the missing word.
exercises.text: ___ Arlan code in Python? — Yes, he can!
exercises.hint: Questions: Can + subject + base verb? → "Can Arlan code?"

exercises.text: Bekzat is not good at languages. He ___ speak Chinese.
exercises.hint: can't + base form. Never 'to', never 'cants', never 'don't can'.
Short answer: Yes, + subject + can. "Yes, she can."

exercises.text: When Bekzat was 10, he ___ run very fast — but now he is even faster!
exercises.hint: Past ability → could. "When I was young, I could run fast."

exercises.text: "Can you to explain this again, please?" is correct.
exercises.hint: No "to" after can! "Can you explain this again?" — base form directly after can.
